professional_title: Senior System Analyst | Software & Solutions Development
headline: Translating complex healthcare requirements into reliable, testable digital solutions.
professional_summary: Senior System Analyst with 20 years of progressive experience across healthcare service, medicine management, managed-care operations and IT, including seven years in systems analysis. Skilled at investigating complex problems, facilitating stakeholder discovery, translating clinical and business rules into detailed specifications, and validating solutions through functional testing. Holds a Diploma in ICT: Applications Development and is actively developing full-stack Java, Spring Boot and Angular solutions. Combines deep healthcare-domain knowledge with structured analysis, practical solution design and a strong eye for usable interfaces.
